ECTV scripts · October 12, 2026 to June 4, 2027

  1. Open your week, then your day below.
  2. Find your job. Read only your lines.
  3. Rehearse before the show. Refresh if a line changes.

Find your job

  • Announcer 1 - Blue lines
  • Announcer 2 - Green lines
  • Weather presenter - Orange lines
  • Producer / computer - Yellow cues. Do not read aloud.

Yellow blanks: read your first name, the checked weather or lunch, or the wording from your producer card instead.
